_comment: Etsy shop sections (ADR-054). Deterministic: a product's section comes from its canonical product_format (product.json concept) plus its structured season (product.json season) or topic (product.json product_type), matched by whole word against the lists below. Keys: '<format>:<theme>' first, then '*:<theme>', then '<format>'. A listing belongs to ONE section, so a seasonal or topic section wins over the format section. A recognised season with no seasonal section (e.g. winter) is a warning, never filed under the generic format section. No match = no section (a warning, never a guess). Section names are the shop's canonical names; never generated.
